lines.rom: jaya janakinatha jaya sriraghunatha dou kara jorem binavaum prabhu suniye bata
tuma raghunatha hamare prana pita mata tuma hi sajjana sangi bhakti mukti data
lakha caurasi kato meto yama trasa nisidina prabhu mohi rakhiye apane hi pasa
